eyebrow: T-SQL streams results back for free
code:
-- T-SQL: a bare SELECT just streams back to the caller
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.GetActiveCustomers
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT CustomerId, CustomerName
  FROM Customers WHERE IsActive = 1;
END;
caption: Oracle procedures do not behave this way — there's nowhere for a bare SELECT to "go."

eyebrow: A REF CURSOR is a cursor VARIABLE
caption: Opened for a query at runtime, unlike a fixed, named cursor.
The caller fetches from p_customers — the real equivalent of T-SQL's free result set.

eyebrow: The same variable, different queries at runtime
caption: A named cursor's query is fixed at declaration — a REF CURSOR's isn't.
